guild04_defy_1.m: Andor, is that you? You grew weak and small. How was your visit to Nor City?
r: I'm $playername. Andor is my brother and I'm not weak.

guild04_defy_2.m: Oh, yeah, but you do look a lot like him. I'm Defy.
r: So you know my brother as well?

guild04_defy_3.m: Indeed. He always asks questions like a curious kid does. Tell me, what brings you here, $playername?
r: Umar told me that it is time to give their share to the bootleg brewers.
Umar sent me for our business.

guild04_defy_4.m: The time of sharing? If that's so, then tell him that there will be a delay.

guild04_defy_5.m: Just mind your own business, kid. Now, get out of here or I'll kick you out.
r: You will be the one who's kicked out of here.
You will be the one to blame here.

Thieves04.10: Umar told me to visit Defy in Sullengard to instruct him to give the villagers their share.
Thieves04.20: Defy told me that there will be a delay in giving the villagers of Sullengard their fair share for some unknown reason. I must report this to Umar at once.
Thieves04.30: Umar instructed me to talk to Defy once more.
Thieves04.35: Defy and his friends have vanished! Back to Umar ...
Thieves04.40: I told Umar about the disappearance of Defy and his men. But Umar didn't believe me and he even sent me back to find them. I better ask the villagers there.
Thieves04.50: There was a distressed man, whom just had his first child, who hinted to me of wherabouts of Defy and his men. I must report this to Umar once more.
Thieves04.60: With Sullengard running into financial trouble, Umar is enraged by Defy's traitorous way.
Thieves04.70: Umar gave me a task to give the mayor at least 50000 gold coins as the promised share for their living. After that, I'm instructed to report back to him.
Thieves04.75: Sullengard has been given their share of the gold and now it's time to revisit Umar.
Thieves04.80: At last, Sullengard can now sleep calmly and eat sufficiently with their finances restored.
